t: The Geo Scanner provides information about blocks around and chunk where scanner located. Geo scanner has delay between scans, so you should be ready for this.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/geo_scanner/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
地理扫描仪可提供扫描器所在位置周边方块及所在区块的相关信息。地理扫描仪两次扫描之间存在一定延迟，请做好相应准备。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/geo_scanner/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Geo Scanner to a computer to make use of it!
将你的地理扫描仪连接至计算机即可使用！
